**Access:** Server Admin. Owner-only settings need the owner and their password.

post.description:
Wipes every account, message and upload, then stops the process. Cannot be undone; take a backup first.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password and the server domain typed as confirmation.

**Access:** Server Admin.

delete.description:

post.description:
Deletes all users except the owner, plus channels, messages, files, invites and sessions. Settings in config.toml are kept. Cannot be undone.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password and the phrase `RESET`.

Gracefully shuts the server down and starts it again, for example to apply settings flagged as needing a restart. Answers 202 first, then restarts after a short delay; everyone is disconnected for a few seconds. Refused with 409 in docker mode (restart the container) or when the install cannot restart itself.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password.

Replaces ALL current data with the contents of a backup made by the panel. Everyone is signed out, including the caller. Cannot be undone; take a backup first.
The form is read as a stream so the password is checked before the (up to 1 GiB) archive is read:
send `password` and `confirm` BEFORE `file`.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password, the archive passphrase and the phrase `RESTORE`.

parameters.description: Passphrase chosen when the backup was made
parameters.name: passphrase

get.description:
Reports the running version, the newest GitHub release with its notes, how this install was deployed (`binary`, `docker` or `unknown`) and whether it can update itself. In docker mode the manual command is returned instead. `?refresh=1` bypasses the 10-minute release cache and is audited. Also reports the progress of a running update.
**Access:** Server Admin.

post.description:
Downloads the newest release for this platform, verifies it against the release's SHA256SUMS, replaces the server binary (keeping the old one as `.old`) and restarts the process. Returns 202 immediately; poll `GET /api/admin/update` for progress. Refused with 409 in docker mode (use `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`), when the install cannot be updated, when already up to date, or while another update runs. A failed checksum aborts before anything is replaced.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password.

parameters.description: Owner password, and optionally source=upload to install the release uploaded with POST /api/admin/update/upload instead of downloading
parameters.name: body

post.description:
For non-Docker installs without internet access (air-gapped): upload the `cove-server-<os>-<arch>.zip` from a release, or the plain binary, together with its version and optionally its SHA-256 (or the release's SHA256SUMS). The file is streamed to disk (never held in memory), must contain exactly the binary for this platform, and is checked against the checksum when one is given. Nothing is executed. Apply it afterwards with `POST /api/admin/update` and `{"source":"upload"}`. Docker installs are refused: pull the new image instead.
**Access:** Server Owner, with their password (sent before the file).

parameters.description: Version of the uploaded release, e.g. 0.10.0
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Release zip or plain server binary
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Expected SHA-256 of the uploaded file (hex)
parameters.name: sha256

parameters.description: Contents of the release's SHA256SUMS file
parameters.name: sums

get.description:
Returns an ALTCHA v1 challenge. The client searches for the number n in [0, maxnumber] with
SHA-256(salt + n) equal to `challenge`, then sends the base64 JSON
{algorithm, challenge, number, salt, signature} as `captcha` when registering.
Each solution works once and expires after a few minutes. Returns 404 when the check is off.
**Access:** Public.

404.description: the sign-up check is not enabled on this server

**Access:** Channel Member.

post.description:

(`true` for video messages, which are probed and transcoded in the background), `thumb_ciphertext` and
`thumb_nonce` (base64, optional). The stored content type is sniffed from the bytes, never taken from
the client. The response never contains the server-side storage path.
**Access:** Authenticated (channel uploads: Channel Member).

post.description:
Creates a new Cove user account. Depends on the server's registration mode:
**open** lets anyone sign up, **invite_only** needs a valid invite_code, **closed** refuses everyone.
The very first account on a fresh server is always accepted and becomes the server owner.
When the sign-up check is on (captcha_required in /api/server-info) every sign-up except the first must carry a solved proof-of-work challenge in `captcha`.
**Access:** Public.

403.description: registration closed, invite required, invite not valid or demo server full

429.description: too many requests, or too many sign-ups from this IP (demo mode)

everyone|friends|nobody, `friend_request_permission` everyone|nobody.

get.description:
Returns the semantic version of the Cove backend currently running, the API version,
the minimum supported client version and the capabilities the server advertises.
**Access:** Public.
get.summary: Get the current server build version

target.description: e.g. a username or invite code (never a secret)

challenge.description: Challenge is hex(SHA-256(salt + n)) for a secret number n the client has to find.

maxnumber.description: MaxNumber is the upper bound of the search range [0, maxnumber].

salt.description: Salt is random and carries the expiry as ?expires=<unix>.

signature.description: Signature is hex(HMAC-SHA256(server key, challenge)); the server checks it when the solution comes back.

member_system.description: MemberSystem flags built-in system accounts (the server's Cove account) among the members.

owner_only.description:
OwnerOnly keys change network exposure or session security, so only the
owner (with their password) may touch them.

restart_required.description:
RestartRequired keys are saved to the file but only take effect after a
restart. The others are applied live.

code.description: Code is a stable machine-readable code from the registry; clients branch on it, never on Error.

details.description: Details carries optional code-specific data, e.g. min_client_version for client_outdated.

error.description: Error is a human-readable message (or an i18n key the client translates).

server_role.description: ServerRole is "owner" or "admin" for panel users, empty otherwise.

captcha.description:
Captcha is the solved ALTCHA payload (base64 JSON) for a challenge from GET /api/captcha/challenge. It is
required when /api/server-info reports captcha_required.

invite_code.description: InviteCode is required when the server runs in invite-only mode.

password.description: Password is the owner's current password.

captcha_required.description:
CaptchaRequired is true when sign-up needs a solved proof-of-work challenge (GET /api/captcha/challenge).
It is false while the server still has no owner, because that first account is always allowed.

demo.description: Demo is true on a public demo instance; clients show a notice that data resets and is not private.

needs_owner.description: NeedsOwner is true on a fresh server: the next account created becomes the owner.

can_restart.description: CanRestart is true when POST /api/admin/restart can restart this install (binary mode with a restart hook).

can_update.description: CanUpdate is true only when the button may be used right now: binary mode, a newer release and no job running.

check_error.description: CheckError is an i18n key set when GitHub could not be reached; everything else is still filled in.

checked_at.description: RFC3339; when the release list was last fetched

error.description: Error is an i18n key describing why the last update attempt failed.

instructions.description: Instructions is the manual command, set in docker mode.
instructions.example: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d

latest_version.description: empty when no release could be determined

mode.description: Mode is "binary" (plain executable), "docker" (container, never self-replaced) or "unknown".

reason.description: Reason explains a false CanUpdate with an i18n key suffix: docker, unsupported, up_to_date, busy.

release_notes.description: GitHub release body (Markdown), truncated to 16 KiB

source.description:
State is the progress of an update started with POST: idle, downloading, installing, restarting or failed.
Source is where the release list came from: "manifest" (covechat.dev or a configured mirror) or "github".

uploaded.description: Uploaded describes a manually uploaded release waiting to be applied (air-gapped installs).

role.description: Role is 0 (member) or 10 (admin). Ownership cannot be granted through this endpoint.

password.description: Password is the owner's current password (step-up for replacing the server binary).

source.description: Source is "release" (default: download the latest) or "upload" (install the staged manual upload).

verified.description: Verified is true when a checksum was supplied and matched; false means the owner chose to trust the file.

server_role.description: ServerRole is only filled in for the caller's own account (/api/me), never for other users.

api_version.description: APIVersion is the integer client/server contract version, bumped only on breaking changes.

capabilities.description: Capabilities names the optional features this server supports; clients gate UI on these, not on versions.

min_client_version.description: MinClientVersion is the oldest client semver the admin supports; empty when none is set.
